description: This file defines interfaces for the IOcdm and IOcdmFactory classes, which are part of the Rialto media server component. It declares methods for creating and accessing a singleton instance of IOcdm, and for checking if a specific DRM key system is supported.

classes.name: IOcdm
classes.description: Interface for DRM system support, providing a method to check if a key system is supported.

classes.name: IOcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving the singleton IOcdm instance.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IOcdmFactory instance.

methods.name: getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IOcdm instance.

methods.name: isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the specified key system is supported by the DRM system.
